video:video.video:title: Black bear kills a man and dog near a south Florida nature preserve
video:video.video:description: Authorities say they are searching for a black bear that killed a man and a dog in south Florida.

video:video.video:title: Owen Wilson reflects on his unexpected path to comedy roles
video:video.video:description: Owen Wilson says there's "a fine line between something being funny or sad." Premiering his new golf series "Stick," Wilson says he never anticipated becoming a comedy star.

video:video.video:title: Costa Rica Prison officers catch cat carrying two packages of drugs

video:video.video:title: Netanyahu says Israeli military has launched 'powerful' campaign against Hamas in Gaza

video:video.video:title: The day London went 'barmy.' An East End boy remembers the end of World War II in Europe

video:video.video:description: Portugal’s president will start Tuesday to convene the country’s political parties for consultations, after a general election delivered another minority government as well as an unprecedented showing by populist party Chega (Enough) that added momentum to Europe’s shift to the far-right.

video:video.video:description: During an inaugural Mass in St. Peter’s Square before tens of thousands of people, presidents, patriarchs and princes, Pope Leo XIV received two crucial signs of his pontificate, the “pallium” and the fisherman’s ring, marking his role as successor of Peter.

video:video.video:description: Some pro athletes are turning to trained protection dogs like Lobo the German shepherd to guard their homes.

video:video.video:title: Hundreds of desperate Palestinians storm into a WFP warehouse in Gaza

video:video.video:title: Trump threatens tariffs on Apple and other tech companies unless phones are made in the US
video:video.video:description: President Donald Trump says tariffs are coming for all foreign-made smart phones, not just Apple products.

video:video.video:title: Bryan Cranston says 'Breaking Bad' would've made a 'terrible' movie
video:video.video:description: Bryan Cranston says “Breaking Bad” needed time to tell its story — and would’ve made a “terrible” movie.

video:video.video:title: Why the Trump administration may want Ukraine's minerals

video:video.video:title: Seal on papal ring annulled at the Vatican
